leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a brute-force solution to calculate the maximum sum of all subarrays of size K
Apply the sliding window technique to optimize the brute-force solution
Construct a function that maintains a running sum while sliding the window across the array
Initialize and update variables to track the current window sum and maximum sum found
Manipulate array indices to correctly define the window boundaries at each step
Configure loop conditions to iterate through the array exactly once using the sliding window
Integrate edge case handling for empty arrays or invalid window sizes
lessonTitle: Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K
